name: Weighted Fist
description: Strike with a fist made heavy beyond its size by qi laid on qi through the field.

name: Laden Press
description: Lay a rising weight upon the target through the palm until it can no longer lift an arm.

name: Sapping Hold
description: Hold the target in a grip whose weight drains its strength the longer it struggles.

name: Hardening Rouse
description: Harden the muscles of the user or an ally with a dense surge of qi so blows and loads weigh less.

name: Crushing Descent
description: Leap and fall upon the target with the full piled weight of the body and the field.

name: Immense Brace
description: Brace the frame under a mass so immense that blows from larger bodies cannot move it.

name: Mauling Heave
description: Seize a target and heave it down with such weight that its footing and its guard both fail.

name: Weight Gift
description: Lend an ally a share of the piled weight so that its blows fall with the user's mass.

name: Overwhelming Fist
description: Throw a fist whose weight bears through guard and bone and out the other side of the target.

name: Colossal Embrace
description: Close both arms about the target with a weight that squeezes the breath and the fight out of it.

name: Colossal Smash
description: Bring both fists down on the ground so the shock of the piled weight strikes everything around.

name: Reckoning Weight
description: The school's final tally in which every blow ever struck is loaded into one that falls on the target.

name: Unbearable Weight
description: Drop the whole piled mass upon the front; its ruin reaches the destructive ceiling of this tier and levels what stands there.

name: Toppling Stance
description: Stand as a titan about to topple so that an attacker must fear the fall as much as the blow.

name: Hurled Mass
description: Hurl the whole bulk of the body into the target to knock it off its feet.

name: Titan Seizure
description: Seize the target in hands vast enough to cover it and hold it against all struggle.

name: Tireless Surge
description: Flood the Core's qi through the frame of the user or an ally so strength does not flag.

name: Toppling Blow
description: Fall forward with the whole frame behind a fist so the blow lands as a toppling mass.

name: Stalwart Brace
description: Hold the titan's brace against a blow that would flatten smaller frames and give no ground.

name: Giant Hurl
description: Seize a target with both hands and hurl it clear across the field with a titan's strength.

name: Falling Sweep
description: Sweep both arms down and round as the titan falls so all targets in reach are struck.

name: Colossus Rending
description: Rend the target's guard and frame apart with a blow that carries the full mass of the Core.

name: Colossus Sweep
description: Swing both arms in one sweep that strikes and flings every target within the user's reach.

name: Ponderous Judgment
description: Lay a vast and slow weight upon the target that judges its strength and finds it wanting.

name: Titan Judgment
description: The school's great stroke in which the titan's fall is made the sentence and the sentence is carried out.

name: Cataclysmic Fall
description: Fall with the Core's full weight upon the front; the ruin reaches the destructive ceiling of a Core-tier cultivator and shatters whatever stands there.

name: Collapse Absolute
description: Bring the titan's weight down on one target; the blow reaches the destructive ceiling of its tier and the target is driven under.

name: Bearer Fist
description: Throw a fist that carries the weight of the burden the bearer has borne.

name: Bearer Stance
description: Stand under the burden as one who has never set it down and cannot be moved.

name: Burden Seizure
description: Lay hold of the target and make it share the weight of the burden until it sinks.

name: Bearer Vigor
description: Share the bearer's endurance with an ally so that it carries its own weight easily.

name: Bearer Crush
description: Bring the full borne weight to a point in the fist and crush what it touches.

name: Weight Unyielding
description: Hold the burden before the body as a mass no blow can shift or pierce.

name: Burden Release
description: Take the weight of a curse or binding upon the bearer's own back and cast it from the user or an ally.

name: Burden Sweep
description: Sweep the burden round in a wide arc that strikes every target about the bearer.

name: Starbearing Fist
description: Drive a fist that bears the weight of the heavens and pierces what it falls on.

name: Bearer Embrace
description: Gather the target into the bearer's arms and squeeze with a mass beyond any single frame.

name: Burden Press
description: Press the burden outward over the front so all within it are held down and shaken.

name: Bearer Decree
description: The school's decree in which the bearer lays the whole burden on one foe and none may bear it.

name: Burden Judgment
description: The school's great stroke in which the bearer sets the burden down as a verdict on all before it.

name: Burden Annihilation
description: Set down the burden of a world upon the front; its ruin reaches the destructive ceiling of a Divine-tier cultivator.

name: Worldbearer Collapse
description: Drop the bearer's whole weight on one target; the blow reaches the destructive ceiling of its tier and crushes the target flat.
